g.text: Measure tokens, correctness and p50/p95 time;
retrieval → routing → generation → validation / database → total task time
Compare one-shot versus bounded repair separately. Inspect stage times before assigning causality.
One sales domain is the first experimental scope. No latency improvement has been measured in this review.
